description: Accuracy Shipping Limited provides third party logistics solutions in India and internationally. Its logistics services consist of a suite of solutions, including customs house clearance, clearing and freight forwarding, shipping, air freight, consolidation, sea-air services, inland transportation, distribution, warehousing, cross trades, and overseas warehousing, as well as value added services. The company also sells petroleum and petroleum products; and motor vehicles. It serves marbles and granite, ceramic tiles, paper, agriculture, machinery, rubber, chemical, textiles, and other industries. The company was incorporated in 2000 and is based in Anjar, India.
